snippet.title: Carry the Count: Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4311440/Carry_The_Count/

Carry the Count is a co-op adventure game for 1 to 4 freaky little freaks. Carry your vampire master across a medieval fantasy world to his bloodthirsty lover Romilda. Fight barbarians, solve puzzles, outsmart evil fish guys, and don't let the masters coffin break. Maybe one day, Igors will be free?

🔗 All Socials & Discord: https://linktr.ee/LittleBirdStudios

#CarryTheCount #indiegame  #adventuregame  #indiedeveloper #steam #adventure
